status: One complete candidate; independent final published-head reviews and integrator combined release remain required. Entire MSH set acceptance remains open.
printed_obligations: Cast an instant for one generic and one red mana without any mandatory sacrifice/discard requirement.
Present the optional private resolution payment even if neither route is affordable.
Pay exactly one controlled artifact sacrifice or one owned hand-card discard, including lands, or decline.
Draw two cards exactly once after committed payment and its replacements; decline skips the draw.
shared_core: Append the typed SacrificeOrDiscard choice, with a discard-only nonland flag; preserve prior variant order.
Reuse ChooseObjects, the existing exact-reference owned choice, and current sacrifice/discard/decline action vocabulary.
Capture the payer/cause from the resolving packet; the active player and permanent owner do not substitute for that controller.
Keep the entire union view private; maintain the same phase/quota when hidden nonland eligibility differs.
Commit one selected route through existing zone/discard events. Exile or self-shuffle replacements still pay the cost.
No hot object field, new pending framework, parser, token ID, mana funding union, activation union or ward union.
rules_cases: Both seats, own/opponent turns, actual one-red plus one-generic payment, sacrifice/discard-land/decline/no resources.
Wrong actor, wrong route, wrong controller/zone, stale sacrifice incarnation and invalid alternatives leave snapshots/state_bytes unchanged.
Stolen and tapped artifacts, the same Lotus used for casting mana, indestructible artifact creatures, and artifact land tokens qualify.
Actual optional nonland choice creation with zero eligible cards has identical complete nonactor observation to an eligible hidden hand.
Actual mandatory typed choice creation exposes no decline; pay exactly one route.
Rest in Peace discard/sacrifice exile, Progenitus/Colossus self-shuffle, Finality competing replacement ordering and zero premature draws.
Self-discard Wilt-Leaf Liege on opponent turn verifies the captured cause; paid cost triggers draw after replacement exactly once.
Every checked action covers owned raw/index branching after parent disposal, wrong-actor atomicity, snapshot restore and stale revision.
